campaign.title: M1 D=1 signed outer-defect theta zero-mode gate

resource_policy.literature_policy: Audit primary primitive and imprimitive quadratic Gauss-sum formulas, induced real-character Fourier transforms, Ramanujan factors, zero-argument Salie or theta sums, Polya--Vinogradov, Burgess, and conductor-lowering results only against the exact arbitrary-N weighted zero row. Record conductors, prime-power and two-adic hypotheses, support in j, coefficient and endpoint norms, all d-strata, and every restored N-M-V power.

frozen_target.question: For the exact v=0 row of the D=d=L=1 signed outer-defect theta completion beyond every fixed polylogarithmic collar, can the zero-frequency theta multiplier be evaluated into primitive or induced real-character local factors and then summed against the literal Bhat_j(0) to prove the X^epsilon target or a strict owner-complete positive-power range; if not, what is the first exact conductor, valuation-support, squareful, profile-variation, endpoint, source, or restored-power obstruction?
frozen_target.reference_formula: Fix A>0, q=4N, J_A=M^(3/4)(log(2X))^A, K=sqrt(NM), and J_A<V<=K. For every odd d|N put c=4N/d. The frozen row is -i(1+i)/(2Nq) sum_(V<|j|<=2V) sum_(d|N,d odd) chi_4(d)d sqrt(c) Bhat_j(0)K(0,-j;c), where K(0,-j;c)=sum_(a mod c)^* epsilon_a(c/a)e_c(-aj), and Bhat_j(0)=sum_(x mod q)B_j(x) retains the literal pre-linearization profile, cell, mask, transitions, and endpoints.
quantities: Retain arbitrary N, every odd d|N, c=4N/d, both signs of j, the strict dyadic mask, actual profile, zero extension, asymmetric cell, transitions, hard endpoints, and external B_(1,U)(1) seam.
The accepted selected linearization is not licensed on the ambient B_j; use the exact residual phase in the zero row.
Prove epsilon_a=(1+i)/2+(1-i)chi_4(a)/2 and decompose K(0,-j;4m) exactly, then derive rather than assume the primitive conductors of (m/a) and chi_4(a)(m/a).
Classify every prime-power Fourier transform, including p=2, induced-modulus multiplicity, principal-character case, squareful degeneration, nonvanishing valuation of j, phase, and magnitude.
Restore the exterior d sqrt(c)/(2Nq), all d, the number and location of surviving j, and every Bhat_j(0) variation or endpoint cost before assigning a power.
Direct interchange of j and a, Gauss evaluation, partial summation, Polya--Vinogradov, Burgess, conductor lowering, and divisor switching must be tested with their literal hypotheses.
Complete v-resummation, termwise DFI, physical-diagonal-only Parseval, bare flat-j localization, and the hypothetical V<=M^(3/2) capacity are frozen as gains.
Support counts, local magnitudes, character-sum bounds, and theorem right sides are upper capacities, not signed lower bounds.
A zero-row theorem does not automatically control the nonzero matrix or any D>1, L>1, generic, t>=2, cross, M2, endpoint, M9, bridge, target, or exponent owner.

completion_criteria: Write the exact normalized zero row with every selector, Fourier, Gauss, multiplier, gcd, profile, mask, sign, and endpoint factor.
Decompose the zero-frequency theta multiplier into exact real-character additive transforms and derive their primitive conductors and induced-modulus formulas.
Compute every odd and two-adic local factor, nonvanishing condition in j, principal or squareful degeneration, exact phase, and magnitude.
Derive the literal j-variation and weighted partial-summation norms of Bhat_j(0), rather than replacing it by a separated constant.
Produce a complete N-M-V-d-conductor ledger after every outer variable, support restriction, and endpoint is restored.
Prove the full zero-row target, isolate a strict owner-complete positive-power range, or establish the first exact conductor, local-factor, support, profile, endpoint, source, or power obstruction.
Source-audit every imported Gauss-sum, induced-character, maximal character-sum, conductor-lowering, or zero-argument theta theorem against the literal arbitrary-N row.
Close under exactly one label: outer_defect_zero_mode_target, strict_outer_defect_zero_mode_range, or outer_defect_zero_mode_arithmetic_no_go.

review_seams.requirement: The exact normalized row retains arbitrary N, every d, both signs, actual B_j, mask, cell, transitions, endpoints, and external coefficient seam.
Both real-character pieces have exact primitive conductors, induced-modulus factors, all prime powers, p=2, squareful cases, and j-support printed.
The literal Bhat_j(0) variation, every d and support multiplicity, endpoints, and complete N-M-V-conductor power are restored before a gain.
